🇺🇿 Would you visit Uzbekistan with just $10 in your pocket? From the legendary Silk Road cities and massive gold mines to the mysterious disappearance of the Aral Sea, Uzbekistan is full of surprises!
💬 What fascinates you most about this country — its incredible history, beautiful culture, affordable lifestyle, or the story of the vanished sea?
👇 Comment below! And if you could visit ONE place in Uzbekistan, would you choose Samarkand or Tashkent?
